They take him in, they stabilize him. It takes them a couple hours. They wake him up and the doctor pulls me and my mom into the room and says, Hey guys, we have two options. We can do comprehensive testing to figure out what's going on, or we can rush into surgery and put a defibrillator inside his heart. Both options would cost us 60k or 150k, respectively. It would completely bankrupt my family. So we decided to wait. After my brother was stable, we went back home. And for the next couple of months I was searching on Reddit for solutions.
